hook.text: Odysseus tied himself to the mast to resist the Sirens. He engineered his future self's behavior. That's commitment.

buildup.text: Commitment devices are voluntary constraints you place on yourself now to prevent poor choices later.

discovery.text: StickK lets you pledge money to a cause you hate if you fail your goal. Users with financial stakes succeed 78% more.

twist.text: Commitment works because our present self can't trust our future self. Temptation degrades willpower.

climax.text: The best commitment devices make the bad choice expensive, embarrassing, or impossible. Future-you'll thank present-you.

punchline.text: Bind your future self before temptation arrives.

quiz.question: Why do commitment devices work?
options: They make poor future choices more costly, bypassing temptation
They eliminate all bad options permanently
